description: This file defines the BufferStream class implementing the StreamInterface, providing buffer management with read/write capabilities and high water mark handling.

classes.name: BufferStream
classes.description: A final class implementing a buffer stream with read/write operations and high water mark management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes BufferStream with an optional high water mark.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the contents of the buffer as a string.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Retrieves and clears the buffer contents.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Closes the buffer and returns null.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates the stream is not seekable.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the position to the start.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is empty.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Throws exception; position cannot be determined.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes string to buffer, returns 0 if buffer exceeds high water mark.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns high water mark if key is 'hwm', otherwise null or empty array.
